curriculum: The English-taught Groningen BA English Language and Culture is 180 EC. The example follows September 2026 entrants, for whom the dated scheme records six first-year courses worth 10 EC each. Year two combines three compulsory 10 EC courses, one 10 EC IMPACT selection and four 5 EC electives. Year three has a 30 EC minor or free space, four different 5 EC electives, and the 10 EC Portfolio or BA Thesis. The required LEX004B10 is listed in semester two and gives a thematic individual portfolio or a thesis for some students. The older LEX003B10 is listed separately and uses legacy requirements. This example represents the shared interdisciplinary degree and keeps a balance of literature, linguistics, communication and global culture, while preparing for the linguistics final project.
progression: The first semester introduces structure and social contexts in English Linguistics 1, Professional English 1 and Understanding English Literatures. The second includes medieval literature, Professional English 2 and mediated identities. Professional English 2 builds on the first course. In year two the compulsory first-semester courses cover cognition and language development, identities and ideologies, and Anglophone literary transformations. The IMPACT selection runs across semester two. Sociolinguistics Laboratory and Flux occupy group A, with World Literatures in English and Learning and Teaching English in group B. The Laboratory requires a positive first-year study recommendation and completed English Linguistics 1. The plan completes these and has 60 EC from year two, including three LET courses: the compulsory cognitive linguistics course, Laboratory and Learning and Teaching English. This clears the published LEX004B10 threshold of all 60 first-year EC plus 50 further EC including three linguistics courses before the final project. Professional English 3 is moved to Year 3 group B and follows completed Professional English 1. Language in Interaction and Strangers occupy group A, with Literary Theories and Professional English 3 in group B. Each group has two different electives. Future years use the dated scheme as the published planning example.

This course is open for students that have obtained all 60 ECTS from year 1 and 50 ECTS from year 2/3 in the BA English Language and Culture. The 50 ECTS from year 2 and/or 3 must include, per specialization:

[b]Modern Literature[/b]
At least three Modern Literature courses from the BA English Language and Culture (LEL code)

[b]Medieval Literature[/b]
at least two Medieval Literature courses from the BA English Language and Culture (LEO code)
plus a third Medieval Literature course (LEO code) or Modern Literature course (LEL code)

[b]Linguistics[/b]
At least three English Linguistics courses from the BA English Language and Culture (LET code)
